intro: RadioGroup coordinates a set of radio items so people can choose exactly one option. Zentauri UI provides a compound RadioGroup API with shared value, name, required, orientation, size, appearance, and animated indicator support.
useCases: Plan selection in pricing and billing flows.
Settings where one mode must be active.

faqs.question: Does RadioGroup manage exclusive selection?
faqs.answer: Yes. RadioGroupItem components receive the group name and selected value from context, so only one item in the group is selected.

faqs.question: Can RadioGroup be horizontal?
faqs.answer: Yes. Set orientation="horizontal" on RadioGroup for compact rows of options.

faqs.question: Is there an animated RadioGroup?
faqs.answer: Yes. Import RadioGroupAnimated and RadioGroupItemAnimated from the animated entrypoint for a spring or fade selected indicator.

sections.heading: What it does
sections.body:
Coordinate exclusive selection across related radio items.

Use RadioGroup when exactly one option should be selected from a known list.

sections.heading: Composition and API
sections.body: Use RadioGroup as the root and RadioGroupItem for each option. The root owns value, defaultValue, onValueChange, orientation, size, appearance, required, and disabled state.

sections.heading: Accessibility
sections.body: The component renders a radiogroup wrapper and native radio inputs. Provide an aria-label or external label for the group, and keep each item label clear.

sections.heading: Next.js integration notes
sections.body: Keep controlled RadioGroup examples in client components. Use defaultValue for simple server-rendered defaults in App Router pages.
